Id.description: Use the id field to define the identifier for this Direct Deposit record.

BankName.description: Use the Bank Name field to define the name of the employee’s financial institution.

BankAddress.description: Use the Address field to enter the financial institution’s street address, including the street number, street name, and suite number (if applicable).

BankCity.description: Use the City field to enter the financial institution’s city.

BankState.description: Use the State field to enter the financial institution’s state. You can enter the entire state name or the two-character state abbreviation.

BankZip.description: Use the Zip field to enter the financial institution’s ZIP Code. The field is preformatted to accept the optional four-digit extension.

TransitRoutingNumber.description: Use the Routing # field to define the financial institution’s routing or transit number for this Direct Deposit record. Do not include dashes or spaces. Once you enter a Routing Number, the Account # is required.Number

AccountType.description: Use the Account Type field to select either 1 (Checking) or 2 (Savings) for this Direct Deposit record.

AccountNumber.description: Use the Account Number field to define the employee’s account number for this Direct Deposit record. Do not include dashes or spaces. You may enter alpha or numeric characters.

Amount.description: The Amount field for the Primary account will not have an amount value. The Amount field is a required entry for other(non-primary) accounts.

PrimaryDeposit.description: Set this value to true to designate this account as the default account for the employee’s direct deposits. If the employee has more than one bank account listed, the account designated as the Primary account will always show first.

Notes.description: Enter any notes pertaining to this Direct Deposit record. If you enter more than one line of information, the system automatically wraps the lines of information for you.

BeginDate.description: Enter the beginning date of the employee’s time off.

ReturnDate.description: Enter the date the employee could be expected back to work. Typically this is going to be the day after the last day of the time off. For instance, if the employee requests to be off on 12/15/15, you would enter 12/16/15 as the Return Date.

Hours.description: Enter the number of hours of the employee has planned. The system uses the Hours entries to compute the Total Hrs Planned. The entries do not affect the employee’s pay.

Comments.description: Enter any comments about the selected time off record. It is a good idea to enter a Comment if another person needs to assume responsibilities or take calls while this Contact is on vacation.
